static_traits.name: Li Mingchen
static_traits.family_status: Has an elder sister and a nephew; relationship tension with sister over forgetting to watch the nephew
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends, but has not yet shared the specific problem due to shame about the mistake
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological issues before;has not yet received psychotherapy;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic; emotions marked by anxiety and feeling overwhelmed; able to self-reflect and cooperate with exploration; perfectionism tendency and catastrophizing present

basic_info.main_problem: I feel anxious and overwhelmed because I forgot to watch my nephew, and therefore believe they will never let me watch him again.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this incident significantly affected my mental health and self-esteem; I think I need to establish facts rather than always assuming the worst outcome.

core_beliefs: I must be perfect; I cannot make mistakes
I am not worthy of trust

special_situations.event: Missing an appointment to babysit a nephew
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, family will never trust me again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately calls the older sister to apologize, and repeatedly replays the event in the mind to try to 'prevent recurrence'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will never let me watch my nephew again

special_situations.event: Recalling the incident without yet receiving clear feedback from the sister
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Without explicit positive confirmation, it means the other person has already negated me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding further communication with the sister, delaying direct contact in uncertain situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She must think I am unreliable

special_situations.event: When studying, thinks of this mistake; attention is interrupted
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot always maintain perfect performance and focus, it equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing myself to 'improve' through self-reproach and repeated review of mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is a huge failure; I am an unreliable person

special_situations.event: When thinking of seeking support from friends or bringing it up
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends know I made a mistake, they will look down on me and think I am unreliable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids talking with friends about this matter, chooses to bear it alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am not worthy of trust

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be trusted and accepted by family, maintaining a reliable image
core_conflict.fear: Fears being rejected by my sister and family, losing trust, and being excluded from family activities
defense_goal: Maintaining a perfect and reliable self-image to avoid being negated
Reducing the risk of rejection by avoiding direct conversation

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges / family members who may reject and exclude (older sister)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate directly with her older sister to clarify trust and the relationship
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to believe direct communication will bring worse outcomes (further negation and exclusion)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a hesitant tone, using wording like 'maybe / not sure / wait a bit more', emphasizing the worst possibilities to justify postponing communication, avoiding clear action commitments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether one shares with friends and seeks support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting inner shame and worries about not being accepted as others looking down on them
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding disclosure, using third-person hypotheticals about others' negative evaluations (e.g. 'they will think I am unreliable'), thereby stopping further discussion.

manifestations: Worries about completely losing the trust of the sister and family and being excluded from family activities
Avoids sharing with friends and seeking help due to shame, tending to bear it alone

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Berates himself by perfectionist standards ('this is a huge failure')
Repeated self-examination and criticism, worrying any imperfection will be negated

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not seeking support from friends, choosing to bear it alone and self-punish
Knowing communication might bring clarification yet choosing to delay or avoid

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming the sister and friends will think they are unreliable, despite lacking clear evidence
Presetting the other's negative evaluation before receiving clear feedback

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of making a mistake and worrying family will no longer trust them, the client usually ruminates repeatedly, catastrophizes predictions, and avoids communication, leading to intensified anxiety and affected sleep and appetite.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On the night of realizing missing watching the nephew, the client did not keep avoiding but immediately called the sister with a sincere apology and willingness to make amends; the sister was displeased but did not explicitly indicate permanent loss of trust, and the relationship remains communicable.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: promptly taking responsibility and communicating directly; different understanding: realizing the need to establish facts rather than assume the worst, thus taking clarifying action.

positive_force: Having self-reflection ability and willingness to try reality testing and thought restructuring
Apologizes promptly and takes responsibility, keeping channels of communication with family open
Has a few close friends who can provide potential support
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking
Shame and tendency to avoid communication
Persistent rumination causing disturbed sleep and appetite, impaired academic functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing and repeatedly recalling the incident escalating anxiety
antecedent: Thinking about missing the occasion of looking after the nephew
Recalling the sister's reaction when alone
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionism and fear of losing family trust; forms a cognitive processing pattern dominated by catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: Escaping the threat of uncertainty and being negated, gaining the illusion of a sense of 'control'
target_behavior.consequence: Declining academic performance, changes in sleep and appetite, continuously worsening anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding communication with and seeking support from significant others (elder sister, friends)
antecedent: Thinking about clarifying with the older sister or sharing this with friends
When experiencing shame and unbearable emotions
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being evaluated and rejected, projecting inner shame as others' negative views
target_behavior.function: Briefly reducing anxiety about facing criticism, avoiding possible conflicts and embarrassment
target_behavior.consequence: Family relationships further strained, persistent uncertainty, maintaining the anxiety and rumination cycle
